content: {"episode_id":"ep-05028","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that the required prior authorization was not obtained.
